request.style: English, solo male voice, warm and clear, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, gentle percussion, hopeful and steady, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Uzziah lived apart in a separate house
A leper cut off from the house of the Lord
His son Jotham took charge of the palace
He governed the people of the land with care

[Chorus]
Jotham walked steadfastly before the Lord
His ways were ordered in the sight of God
He grew powerful through his faithful heart
The righteous king of Judah in the land

[Verse]
He rebuilt the Upper Gate of the house of the Lord
And did extensive building on the wall of Ophel
He built cities in the hill country of Judah
And forts and towers in the wooded areas

[Chorus]
Jotham walked steadfastly before the Lord
His ways were ordered in the sight of God
He grew powerful through his faithful heart
The righteous king of Judah in the land

[Verse]
He went to war against the king of the Ammonites
And defeated them in that year of battle
They paid him silver, wheat, and barley
For three years the tribute came to him

[Chorus]
Jotham walked steadfastly before the Lord
His ways were ordered in the sight of God
He grew powerful through his faithful heart
The righteous king of Judah in the land

[Outro]
Isaiah saw the vision concerning Judah
In the days of Jotham king of Judah
